_readme: Pilot college profile. Every figure carries value + year + source + status. status: 'official' = read from the institute's own page/PDF; 'secondary' = from a news/aggregator page, team must verify against official report; 'missing' = not found, leave null and the page hides that block. Never fill a null from memory.
name: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay

address.value: Adi Shankaracharya Marg, Powai, Mumbai, Maharashtra

route.value: JEE Advanced rank via JoSAA (B.Tech, B.S., B.Tech+M.Tech). B.Des via UCEED (separate route, not JoSAA).

value.note: 11 specialisations per aggregator; confirm list against acad.iitb.ac.in/admissions/bachelors
Chemistry, Economics, Mathematics, Applied Geophysics per aggregator

seats.todo: Take programme-wise seat matrix (gender-neutral + female-only) from the official JoSAA seat matrix PDF for 2026. Aggregator figures conflict (1,204 / 1,360 / 1,368 total), so none are used.

fees.tuitionExemption: SC, ST and PwD students are exempt from the Rs 1,00,000 tuition only. Other per-semester items still apply.

firstSemesterPayable.note: before adjusting the seat acceptance fee (Rs 25,000 for general/EWS/OBC, Rs 10,000 for SC/ST/PwD) paid at JoSAA; mess advance is paid separately

fees.caveat: IIT Bombay states it may revise fees in later semesters. Do not show a 4-year total as official; if shown, label it an estimate.

placements.source: Times of India report relayed by https://www.freepressjournal.in/education/iit-bombay-average-salary-hits-rs-2645-lakh-1422-students-placed (updated 19 May 2026); counts also on https://collegedunia.com/news/iit-bombay-placements-2025-report-out-alertid-153518
caveats: Scope is all programmes together, not B.Tech only.
Placement rate is reported as ~70% by aggregators, but not stated in the FPJ article. Do not show a percentage until the official report is read.
Figures are from a news report, not the official placement report. Team must read the official report on the IIT Bombay placement site before launch.
Highest-package figures vary by source and year. Not included.

facilities.todo: Hostels, labs, sports, library: collect from iitb.ac.in pages. Photos only from IIT Bombay with permission or own photographs.

contact.todo: Admissions contact from acad.iitb.ac.in (verify before showing).

pulse.todo: Hidden until ASMI supplies the methodology sentence.
